stories.headline: Walker Strikes Gold in His Kansas City Debut
stories.read: Well pardner, Seattle let this one walk in free agency, and the Chiefs scooped him up quick. First ride in that offense and Kenneth Walker III thundered for 173 yards and two scores on the Broncos, the most any back's rushed for with Mahomes under center. That ain't beginner's luck, that's volume and opportunity striking the same vein at once. If you're still sleeping on him in redraft or trade talks, wake up quick, this diamond's already glowing.

stories.headline: Jacobs Rides Off the Range, Lloyd Grabs the Reins
stories.read: The law caught up with Josh Jacobs down in Green Bay. Pending misdemeanor charges landed him on the commissioner's exempt list, and he can't practice or suit up while it hangs over him. That hands the reins to MarShawn Lloyd, finally healthy after two years nursing busted wings, with Kaleb Johnson and Chris Brooks riding shotgun behind him. Go stake your claim on Lloyd on the open range before the rest of the outfit catches wind, a healthy lead back in that offense is cheap gold right now.

stories.headline: McConkey Takes a Spill, Bolts' Passing Game on Watch
stories.read: Chargers' top gun Ladd McConkey took a hit to the ribs in that loss to Arizona and Harbaugh's calling him day to day heading into Sunday. He was hauling in catches all afternoon, five for 82, the lone bright spot in an ugly showing before he went down. If he sits, every other pass catcher in that Bolts camp just got a bigger cut of the throws. Watch the practice reports close before you lock your lineup this week.
